steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each NDA term is matched to the company's policy. A term that differs is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 NDA uses a governing law outside policy

findings.title: Governing law differs from policy
findings.fix: Change the law or get an exception from counsel

outcome.notChecked: Whether the NDA is enforceable in the jurisdiction.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] nda-law.md:12  Governing law differs from policy.
       Fix: Change the law or get an exception from counsel.
[medium] nda-exclusions.md:19  Standard exclusion missing.
       Fix: Add the standard exclusion.
[low] nda-term.md:26  Term with no end date.
       Fix: Set an end date.
Not checked: Whether the NDA is enforceable in the jurisdiction.
pros: Checks a term with no end, a scope with no definition, a missing standard exclusion from the policy, and a governing law that differs from the policy.
cons: Not checked: Whether the NDA is enforceable in the jurisdiction.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-nda-review skill on the records for this review.
